# Belvoir Hotel & Residence

> A hotel and serviced-apartment residence on Belvoir Avenue, 86 Wilkinson Road,
> Freetown, Sierra Leone. Air-conditioned en-suite rooms, studio flats and
> self-catering apartments with full kitchens and balconies, for short and long stays.

## Key facts

- Location: Belvoir Avenue, 86 Wilkinson Road, Freetown, Sierra Leone
- Phone: +232 77 777 063
- Email: info@belvoir-estates.com
- Check-in from 2:00 PM; check-out by 11:00 AM
- Front desk staffed 24 hours
- Rates: rooms from $60/night, studio flats from $100, apartments from $100 to $150
- Extended stays: from $1,000 monthly, $14,000 annually
- Breakfast included with hotel rooms; studio flats and apartments are self-catering
  with breakfast available on request
- Free high-speed WiFi, free private on-site parking, 24-hour electricity
- Airport transfers and Sea Coach water-taxi tickets arranged on request, for a fee
- Non-smoking property with a dedicated outdoor smoking area
- Payment: bank card, Mobile Money or the Flot app, in US dollars or Leones
  (Mobile Money settles in Leones only)

## Notes

Booking directly on this site avoids third-party commission. Availability and prices
shown on the site are live and are the same figures the booking engine charges.
